body: - 2026-10-13: Between the pre-CI commit and the push, write nothing into the tree — not even a run dir's journal line: the push entry's `git diff --quiet` guard refuses a dirty tree, so journal the push after it lands. Extended 2026-11-26: the gate tool is such a writer — the push entry fired as `gate.py run … --operator <n> --run-dir <run dir>` appends its trail into that run dir, which the commit just took, and the guard reads its own trail (measured: chunk 2026-11-25-placing-without-moving-the-view's gated pass, entry 19 red, the unpushed commit amended): fire the push entry with no `--run-dir`.

This session is the gated run of the chunk placing without moving the view. It changes no code, test, script or master and edits no file of the tree's source.
It measured the gated live check R7 once at the operator's host on the real Hyprland compositor: after a placing viola open, the window step had restored the active workspace its move took, and R7 read placed with the active workspace unchanged.
That reading cleared the chunk's gated entry, and the window-placing capability now reads implemented with its clearance. CI on the pushed pre-CI commit read green 7/7.
Still unproven, and not an acceptance of the capability: where keyboard focus lands after the restore, and what a failed restore looks like live.
No count, threshold, bound or qualifier moved; nothing was retired and no new surface was added.
The window step's wait bound of 5 s (decision window-wait-bound): the step now also restores the active workspace its move took; R7 confirmed it on the live compositor with no change to the bound.
Each compositor read bounded at 5 s (decision hyprctl-read-deadline): the restore of the active workspace goes through compositor reads; the bound is unchanged.

Live readings never gate (decision live-readings-never-gate): R7 is a live reading fired once at the operator's host whose green result cleared a gated entry and let the capability read implemented; a picker should check whether the row still holds as written.

Manual checks are supplemental only, and the manual screen-reader pass gates nothing (decisions manual-checks-supplemental-only, manual-a11y-pass-gates-nothing): R7 is an operator-fired check on the operator's desktop, not a screen-reader or keyboard pass; check that no row is contradicted.

Orca with foot on Hyprland for the tui (decision screen-reader-target-tui): the measured environment was foot on Hyprland; where keyboard focus lands after the workspace restore is still unproven, which bears on a screen-reader user of the wrapped tui.

Tui terminal belongs to the child, human keystrokes never blocked, and focus, mouse and resize never move the wheel (decisions tui-terminal-belongs-to-child, human-keystrokes-never-blocked, wheel-ignores-terminal-events): the workspace restore can move compositor focus; focus landing after it remains unproven.

Time bounds fall on the driver only, never on the human (decisions time-bounds-fall-on-the-driver, time-bounds-never-on-human): the window step's restore is a driver-side step under its existing bound; nothing new waits on the human.

Gate breach fails the build, zero flakiness, and a11y checks in the GitHub Actions push workflow (decisions a11y-gate-breach-fails-build, zero-flakiness, a11y-ci-github-actions): CI on the pushed commit read green 7/7 with no retries; no threshold moved.
Zero viola bytes on the terminal (decision zero-viola-bytes-on-the-terminal): the window step acts on the compositor, not the terminal; R7 writes no viola byte to the child's terminal.
Linux only (decision linux-only): the restore and its live check are on Hyprland under Linux; no other platform is reached.

The gated run of the placing chunk edited no code, test, script, dependency, config or master; it moved no count and retired nothing.
It measured R7 once at the operator's host on the real Hyprland compositor, unlocked, with a stand-in claude and no real claude CLI: the placing open read placement=placed and the active workspace unchanged, so the wrapper's window step restores the active workspace its move took.
On that reading the gated acceptance clause of the placing capability was cleared and the capability reads implemented; CI on the operator's pre-CI commit read green 7/7.
The R7 placing script and its terminal were terminated and a census found no process of its own left; its runtime directory (stand-in claude, home with pinned binary and plugin folders, diagnostics, work) was left on disk for the operator to remove.
Still unproven after R7: where keyboard focus lands after the restore, and what a failed restore looks like live.

The decision that the wrapper's window step moves only its own terminal's window (state provisional): R7 now proves live that the step's move and its restore of the active workspace act on the real compositor; the row's state is not set standing by this session.
The decision that the Hyprland recorder moves only its own terminal's window: the same window step, now read live by R7 with the active workspace unchanged after the move.

The decision that the R7 placing script acts only on its own terminal: it was fired once, and a process census after it found no R7 script and no process naming its runtime directory, only pre-existing terminals.
The decision that probe artifacts are owner-only and removed: the R7 rig's runtime directory under the user runtime dir was left on disk, not removed, for the operator to remove.
The decisions that the real claude CLI runs only locally and that CI holds no secrets and no real claude: R7 ran at the operator host with a stand-in claude only; CI ran with no change to its jobs.
The decisions on the pinned binary and plugin folders (placed once, kept, never deleted): the R7 home holds a pinned binary folder and a plugin folder keyed by the build hash, left in place.
The decision that focus raises only a window of the session's ancestry: indirect, where keyboard focus lands after the window step's restore is named unproven by R7.
The decision that the hyprctl child is bounded by a deadline: indirect, the window step's compositor calls ran live under R7 and returned within the run (0.83s).
Input validation rows (validators, parsers, caps, frame limits, paste and dialog character sets, MCP and hook input checks): no validator or parser changed.
Authentication and channel rows (peer euid checks, socket directory and modes, strict-modes refusals and their contracts, server verification): no IPC or strict-modes code changed.
Verify's refusal codes, the untrusted-folder refusal included: landed at the take-up's wrap; this gated run carries no change to them.
Dependency security rows (pins, floors, licence and advisory lists, cargo-deny, zizmor, toolchain and MSRV pins, workflow permissions): no dependency, tool pin or workflow changed.
Secret management rows (credential strip, env probes, canary scan, live-rig credentials): no environment handling or scan changed.
Error handling contracts (channel and MCP errors, exit codes, instance-unreachable causes, CLI json errors): no error code or output changed.
The absences (network, hosting, release stage, secrets, accounts): no capability was added.

The gated entry read that reading and went green, so the capability for a placing open that keeps the view was moved from planned to implemented, with its clearance.

Real window placement proven only live: the placing open's view-keeping (the window step putting back the active workspace its move took) now has its gated live reading, R7, read green with the active workspace unchanged.

The sibling rules that each name one gated live reading as the only proof (window raise by R3, fleet re-open by R4, adopt by R5) get a fourth of the same kind: the kept view on a placing open, proven only by R7.

Live reading recorded as a reading, never as verification: R7 is a single operator-fired reading of a successful restore only; keyboard focus after the restore and a failed restore stay unproven, and nothing here proves them.

No manual smoke step and no human-in-loop verification: R7 is an operator-attended gated live reading at the real compositor, fired once on the operator's word; it reaches these rules through the same exception the R3, R4 and R5 readings already hold.
Real claude CLI only locally, never in CI: R7 ran at the operator's host with a stand-in for claude, not the real CLI, and outside CI.
Fake-agent run is not proof of real-CLI behaviour: R7's reading is a statement about the compositor and the window step, not about the real claude CLI, since a stand-in served the child.
